evidence.observation: Pressure 3.066 Torr, near the ramp baseline of about 3.05 Torr
Pressure rose steadily to 3.377 Torr (+0.3 Torr in 480 s), about 10x the noise seen earlier
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint, so the flow controller is not causing the rise
Temperature holding at 750 °C, heater power steady at about 44%
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so air ingress cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: Need to tell a seal leak (air ingress) from an exhaust/pump restriction. Options: a rate-of-rise test with the tube isolated from the pump, checking exhaust line/pump conductance, or an O2/residual-gas reading. No reference band was provided.
